text:
laura: Heads-up thread for KG Labs model onboarding. Need clearance for BYOD (downloadable) SKU + remote-exec marketplace option.
tom: BYOD = customers download weights and run on-prem? remote-exec = partner runs on partner infra but we surface tile?
jenny: correct. remote-exec is partner-hosted serving via marketplace integration (we route). Different legal + telemetry needs.
marcus: ops question  do we require a runner image for remote-exec? If so, they must supply a signed container and a health-check endpoint.
partner-kg: yes we'll provide a signed OCI image and a /healthz endpoint. CI will publish digest to manifest.
compliance-bot: Reminder: for downloadable SKUs we need explicit redistribution grant in the contract (permitted-with-attribution or sublicensable). Also export classification required for NL origin. See: https://redwood.internal/compliance/export-guidance
laura: partner's legal sent a draft dual-license (Apache2 + commercial addendum). Is dual-licensing ok for marketplace?
jenny: dual-license ok but must include a clause restricting redistribution for the commercial SKU. We'll need an addendum that forbids rehosting to third-party marketplaces.
tom: ops: telemetry and telemetry opt-out? Partner requests only aggregated usage metrics and rejects prompt/response logs.
ops-bot: Note: marketplace runtime requires minimal telemetry for billing (token counts). We can accept aggregated counters and hash-only IDs for model versions.
marcus: technical checklist snippet I pasted to the repo:
```
- model_name: KG-Lite-7B
- version: 2026-03-10
- container_digest: sha256:abc123...def456
- sri_integrity: sha256-Base64:Z2h1...==
- artifacts: [weights.pt, config.json, manifest.sig]
- download_allowed: true
- remote_exec: true
- telemetry: aggregated_only
```
laura: legal flagged indemnity language. Partner-provided weights require a warranty that weights do not infringe third-party rights. Partner's counsel pushing back on broad indemnity.
partner-kg: we can provide a limited warranty and a takedown procedure in lieu of full indemnity. Is that acceptable?
jenny: compliance prefers indemnity but accepts alternative mitigation if partner is VC-backed and has insurance. Need partner insurer details.
compliance-bot: Action: open ticket #PL-778 with export-control + insurance cert request. SLA: 3 business days.
tom: marketplace SKU mapping decisions:
- Hosted (redwood-hosted) : KG-Lite-7B (v2026-03)
- Remote-exec : KG-Lite-7B-remote (partner endpoint + signed image)
- Downloadable : KG-Lite-7B-download (weights bundle) - gated by legal ok
laura: marketing ask: partner wants a co-announcement and shared blog. embargo window = partner prefers 2 weeks after listing. We should include joint PR checklist.
marcus: security note  signed manifest must include SLSA provenance or equivalent. We need PGP sig and container image signature.
partner-kg: we'll attach OpenKey v3 signatures and our insurance binder. Can send SLSA provenance attestation.
jenny: once we have insurance + export + redistribution clarity we can greenlight downloadable SKU. If any of those are missing, we default to remote-exec only.
laura: timeline proposal:
- Today: ops checklist + container digest
- Fri: compliance export check + insurance cert (ticket PL-778)
- Next Tue: legal finalize redistribution clause
- Next Wed: staging tile + partner review
- Two weeks after partner OK: publish + co-announcement (per partner embargo)
ops-bot: I'll create a staging tile and enable canary routing. Will flag CPU/GPU quotas per SKU.
compliance-bot: Filed PL-778, assigned to @jenny, due Fri 17:00 UTC.
partner-kg: we'll aim to deliver insurer docs and SLSA by Thursday EOD.
laura: action items recap:
- @jenny: lead compliance ticket + confirm indemnity/insurance sufficiency
- @marcus: verify signed image + SRI manifest in repo
- @tom: create SKU PR and canary config
- @partner-kg: send insurer binder + SLSA attestation
- @ops-bot: create staging tile + canary route
If something slips, escalate here. Thanks all :pray:
